_comment: Guided meditation library. Copy is FINAL (verbatim from Mayana). To add a track later, copy one object and fill it in — no template or player code needs to change. `audioFile` and `coverFile` are object keys inside the `mayanas-professional-site` R2 bucket, appended to site.audio.r2BaseUrl + the matching prefix.
_comment_audioFile: Object keys in the mayanas-professional-site R2 bucket, named after the track (per David). Set exactly as they appear in the bucket — spaces are fine, the player URL-encodes each path segment. CONFIRM 'Breathe In Breathe Out.mp3': on the release the track is 'Breathe In/Breathe Out', and a literal slash in an object key would make it a folder path ('Breathe In/Breathe Out.mp3'), which also works — set whichever matches the bucket. 'Embracing Your Gifts.mp3' is the signup gift and may not be uploaded yet.
_comment_coverFile: RESOLVED — all four launch meditations are tracks on 'Dawning of a New Day' (confirmed from the release's track listing), so that album's cover art applies to each. `cover` is a site path; a bare filename would instead be looked up in the R2 covers prefix.
_comment_album: RESOLVED — these are not standalone singles. Each is a track on 'Dawning of a New Day'. `trackNo` and `sourceTitle` record its position and title on that release, which is also the best clue for matching the R2 audio filenames.

tracks.title: Slowing Down Is A Practice In Self Worth
tracks.audioFile: Slowing Down is a Practice in Self Worth.mp3
tracks.description: This guided meditation gently helps you slow down and create space for mindfulness and relaxation amid the busyness of everyday life. By taking a few moments to pause and breathe, you'll reconnect with your inner calm and cultivate a deeper sense of gratitude for yourself. This grounding practice supports emotional balance, clarity, and empowerment, allowing you to move through your day with renewed presence and peace.
useFor: Reconnecting with inner calm and gratitude
tracks.closing: Let this guided meditation help you slow down, recharge, and realign with a sense of peace and clarity.
tracks.sourceTitle: Slowing Down is a Practice in Self Worth

tracks.title: A Guided Meditation for Trauma
tracks.description: A gentle guided meditation audio that helps you create a safe space to breathe through difficult experiences while fostering mindfulness, self-compassion, and emotional resilience. With careful guidance, this meditation encourages reflection, grounding, and empathy for yourself in the face of trauma, offering relief from tension and mental heaviness.
tracks.closing: Take this intentional pause anytime you need a moment to reconnect with yourself, nurture your healing journey, and approach difficult emotions with patience and dignity.

tracks.title: Guided Meditation — Breathe In, Breathe Out
tracks.description: A calming guided meditation audio designed to help you release what no longer serves you while creating space for mindfulness, self-compassion, and inner strength. With each inhale, invite empowerment and kindness; with each exhale, let go of stress, doubt, and mental heaviness. This meditation is gentle and accessible for beginners while offering a refreshing reset for seasoned meditators.
tracks.closing: Take a moment for yourself whenever you need a mindful pause, a mental reset, or a gentle reminder to reconnect with your inner calm.

tracks.title: Guided Meditation — Breathing in Light
tracks.description: A guided meditation audio that helps you visualize light as a source of love, renewal, and balance. As you breathe, imagine this light moving through your body, bringing warmth and calm to the areas that need it most. This meditation fosters mindfulness, emotional well-being, and inner connection, making it a powerful tool for daily grounding and deeper healing.
tracks.closing: Take a few moments with this guided imagery audio to recharge, reconnect, and invite a sense of calm and balance into your day.

_comment_gift: The free signup gift. Hidden behind the newsletter signup: it appears in the player library once a visitor has signed up (remembered in that browser). Not part of the four-track launch set.

gift.title: Embracing Your Gifts
gift.description: An exclusive guided meditation, offered as a thank you for joining Mayana's list. Settle in somewhere comfortable, and let this be a few minutes that belong only to you.

_comment_intro: Guided Meditation page intro — verbatim from the live site.
intro: Guided meditation can lead you on a journey that creates peace, reflection, calmness or grounding. It is a tool for self care and self understanding. There is a power to slowing down a moment, closing one's eyes and tapping into self as a form of support. Guided meditation is a medium that encourages the mind to still and creates focus as it gives the opportunity to concentrate and reflect on the words, while keeping the mind from drifting.
